test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following fractions is greater than (8)/(5) and less than (7)/(4) ?
solution:
Given:

(8)/(5) = 1.60

(7)/(4) = 1.75

Calculation:

Given options are

(1)/(4) = 0.25

(8)/(3) ≈ 2.67

(2)/(7) ≈ 0.2857

(19)/(11) ≈ 1.73

Hence, only (19)/(11) fits.

**∴ Among the following fractions, (19)/(11) is greater than (8)/(5) and less than (7)/(4).**
